summary: Gorax presents an in-depth guide for Temporal Vortex III against the Freeze boss, highlighting a high-performing Toxin team setup capable of dealing over 1.3 billion damage. He breaks down boss mechanics like Defense Penalty, HP tuning strategies for Oggok and Child of Chaos, gear builds, sub-options for non-legendary setups, and a detailed breakdown of Skill Haste and skill timing synchronization.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.verdict: Essential tank and healer for Temporal Vortex
heroes.note: Provides Immortality and dispels debuffs; needs to achieve a 20s ultimate rotation via scrolls or Skill Haste and hold highest HP to tank Call of Lightning.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Mitigates AoE damage and dispels debuffs; requires Puppeteer set to build ultimate energy and should have second highest HP.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.verdict: Top main DPS for Toxin teams
heroes.note: Deals massive Derivative Poison damage scaling primarily with Enlightenment and Attack.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.verdict: Top Toxin DPS and Aura provider
heroes.note: Provides a +48 Enlightenment Aura and high derivative damage; can use Nightfall Pallium or Orb of the Dragon God.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.verdict: Core Toxin enabler and support DPS
heroes.note: Consistently applies Toxin and boosts team elemental/derivative damage when using Three-Ears Emblem or Erwinding Flesh set.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Provides corrosion debuffs and enhances Serpentemis's damage output when Lothair is unavailable.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: Applies Toxin debuffs and enables Twitch to wear alternative artifacts like Iluya's Fang.

heroes.name: Deeno
heroes.note: Inflicts high Toxin stacks when built with Attack Speed and provides a +36 Enlightenment Aura.

teams.note: Main high-damage Toxin composition capable of scoring 1.16B to 1.3B+ damage.
Alternative composition using Sacredeia instead of Lothair.
Budget-friendly alternative replacing Lothair with epic hero Deeno.

meta_changes: Temporal Vortex III boss inflicts Defense Penalty 1, making double support setups (Oggok + Child of Chaos) standard over single support.
tips: Ensure Oggok has the highest Max HP in the team to absorb Call of Lightning attacks.
Tune Child of Chaos to have the second highest Max HP so he absorbs single-target hits after Oggok dies past 150 boss stacks.
Equip Child of Chaos with the Puppeteer set as he cannot gain ultimate energy directly from ally skills.
When using unscrolled heroes with longer recharge times, adjust all DPS heroes' recast timings to match the longest recast time to maintain rotation synergy.
Focus primary stat gear on Enlightenment for derivative damage dealers like Serpentemis and Lothair.
